title: WebGPU Compute Cloth in Rust: Spring Simulation with wgpu
description: Build a WebGPU cloth simulation in Rust with 3,600 GPU particles, ping-pong storage buffers, spring forces, sphere collision, and live controls.
imageAlt: A checkered WebGPU cloth draped over a sphere beside controls for compute iterations, time step, stiffness, damping, and collision radius.
